_about: Specialist agents of Ada's Continuous Improvement Department. Autonomy levels: 0 = read-only, reports only; 1 = may draft a patch on a branch for Tim to review; 2 = may open a PR; 3 = may deploy low-risk changes. Promotion needs Tim's written say-so and a track record in the ledger (see promotion). Nobody is above 0 today.
